tickets.title: Coordinate divorce document collection
tickets.text: Obtain the filed petition, temporary support materials, and draft property division schedule from Rowan Thimblefern at Lavender Sprocket Family Law for Celia Bramblequill's planning file.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to obtain them by November 8, 2024.

tickets.title: Review beneficiary designations on a recurring cadence
tickets.text: Review beneficiary designations, transfer-on-death registrations, retirement account records, and life insurance beneficiary information for Celia Bramblequill in light of her separation from Soren Bramblequill.
tickets.evidence: Celia requested a review of beneficiary designations, transfer-on-death registrations, retirement account records, and life insurance beneficiary information in light of the separation from Soren; the agreed review date is November 15, 2024.

tickets.title: Coordinate access recovery request
tickets.text: Recover Celia Bramblequill's access to the secure document portal by updating the multifactor authentication phone number currently linked to her account.
tickets.evidence: Celia reported that her secure document portal login fails because the multifactor prompt still goes to a phone number used during the marriage; portal access recovery was agreed for November 4, 2024.

tickets.title: Trace joint brokerage balance discrepancy
tickets.text: Trace the $30,720 difference between Celia Bramblequill's personal household balance sheet ($642,200) and the Velvet Acorn Custody feed ($611,480) for the joint taxable brokerage account.
tickets.evidence: Celia asked for the difference to be traced before the legal team uses the planning figures; the agreed date is November 7, 2024.

tickets.title: Send tax document collection outreach
tickets.text: Coordinate with Galen Nettlewhisk at Cloudberry Kite Tax Group to obtain the prior joint return, year-to-date pay information, withholding records, and estimated tax payment history for Celia Bramblequill.
tickets.evidence: Celia asked Apricot Compass Advisory to coordinate with Galen Nettlewhisk for the prior joint return, year-to-date pay information, withholding records, and estimated tax payment history for cash-flow materials being assembled for counsel; that outreach was agreed for November 12, 2024.

tickets.title: Review concentrated position risk and evidence
tickets.text: Perform cost-basis, tax-lot, and liquidity analysis on the Clockwork Clover Systems position ($252,900) within Celia Bramblequill's joint brokerage account before any proposed division or sale discussion.
tickets.evidence: Mira noted during the portfolio review that the Clockwork Clover Systems position represents a large share of the joint brokerage account and needs cost-basis, tax-lot, and liquidity analysis before any proposed division or sale discussion; the agreed review date is November 22, 2024.
